command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: prepare backing files =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-images /srv/data
sudo -n fallocate -l 1300M /var/lib/lvm-images/disk1.img
ls -lh /var/lib/lvm-images/

echo "== STEP 2: attach loop device =="
LOOP1=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/lvm-images/disk1.img)
echo "LOOP1=$LOOP1"
echo "$LOOP1" | sudo -n tee /var/lib/lvm-images/.loop1 >/dev/null

echo "== STEP 3: create PV/VG/LV =="
sudo -n pvcreate -y "$LOOP1"
sudo -n vgcreate vgdata "$LOOP1"
sudo -n lvcreate -y -n lvdata -L 1000M vgdata

echo "== STEP 4: filesystem + mount =="
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/vgdata/lvdata
sudo -n mount /dev/vgdata/lvdata /srv/data
df -h /srv/data

echo "== STEP 5: seed data =="
sudo -n sh -c 'dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/payload.bin bs=1M count=200 status=none'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "hello lvm" > /srv/data/marker.txt'
sudo -n sh -c 'sha256sum /srv/data/payload.bin /srv/data/marker.txt > /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256'
cat /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256
sudo -n sha256sum -c /srv/data/CHECKSUMS.sha256

echo "== STEP 6: persistence setup =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/attach-lvm-loops.sh >/dev/null <<'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
for img in /var/lib/lvm-images/*.img; do
  losetup -j "$img" | grep -q "$img" || losetup -f "$img"
done
udevadm settle || true
vgchange -ay vgdata || true
EOS
sudo -n chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/attach-lvm-loops.sh

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/lvm-loop-images.service >/dev/null <<'EOS'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop devices backing vgdata LVM PVs
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs-pre.target
After=systemd-udevd.service
Wants=systemd-udevd.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/attach-lvm-loops.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
EOS

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable lvm-loop-images.service

grep -q '/srv/data' /etc/fstab || \
  echo '/dev/vgdata/lvdata /srv/data xfs defaults,nofail,x-systemd.requires=lvm-loop-images.service,x-systemd.device-timeout=30 0 0' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab | grep srv

echo "== BASELINE DONE =="
sudo -n pvs; sudo -n vgs; sudo -n lvs; df -h /srv/data
